create_order.description:
Create a new order in Razorpay. Supports both regular orders and mandate orders. 

For REGULAR ORDERS: Provide amount, currency, and optional receipt/notes. 

For MANDATE ORDERS (recurring payments): You MUST provide ALL of these fields: amount, currency, method='upi', customer_id (starts with 'cust_'), and token object. 

The token object is required for mandate orders and must contain: max_amount (positive number in paise - For INR: 100 paise = ₹1), frequency (as_presented/monthly/one_time/yearly/weekly/daily), type='single_block_multiple_debit', and optionally expire_at (defaults to today+60days). 

IMPORTANT: When token.type is 'single_block_multiple_debit', the method MUST be 'upi'. 

Example mandate order payload: {"amount": 100, "currency": "INR", "method": "upi", "customer_id": "cust_abc123", "token": {"max_amount": 100, "frequency": "as_presented", "type": "single_block_multiple_debit"}, "receipt": "Receipt No. 1", "notes": {"key": "value"}}

amount.description: Payment amount in paise (smallest currency sub-unit). For INR: 100 paise = ₹1. Example: for ₹295, use 29500

currency.description: ISO code for the currency (e.g., INR, USD, SGD)

customer_id.description: Customer ID for mandate orders. REQUIRED for mandate orders. Must start with 'cust_' followed by alphanumeric characters. Example: 'cust_xxx'. This identifies the customer for recurring payments.

first_payment_min_amount.description: Minimum amount in paise for first partial payment (only if partial_payment is true). For INR: 100 paise = ₹1

method.description: Payment method for mandate orders. REQUIRED for mandate orders. Must be 'upi' when using token.type='single_block_multiple_debit'. This field is used only for mandate/recurring payment orders.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for additional information (max 15 pairs, 256 chars each)

partial_payment.description: Whether the customer can make partial payments

receipt.description: Receipt number for internal reference (max 40 chars, must be unique)

token.description: Token object for mandate orders. REQUIRED for mandate orders. Must contain: max_amount (positive number in paise, maximum debit amount - For INR: 100 paise = ₹1), frequency (as_presented/monthly/one_time/yearly/weekly/daily), type='single_block_multiple_debit' (only supported type), and optionally expire_at (Unix timestamp, defaults to today+60days). Example: {"max_amount": 100, "frequency": "as_presented", "type": "single_block_multiple_debit"}

transfers.description: Array of transfer objects for distributing payment amounts among multiple linked accounts. Each transfer object should contain: account (linked account ID), amount (in currency subunits), currency (ISO code), and optional fields like notes, linked_account_notes, on_hold, on_hold_until

amount.description: Amount to transfer in paise (currency subunits). For INR: 100 paise = ₹1

create_payment_link.description: Create a new standard payment link in Razorpay with a specified amount

accept_partial.description: Indicates whether customers can make partial payments using the Payment Link. Default: false

amount.description: Amount to be paid using the link in paise (smallest currency unit). For INR: 100 paise = ₹1. Example: for ₹300, use 30000

callback_method.description: HTTP method for callback redirection. Must be 'get' if callback_url is set.

callback_url.description: If specified, adds a redirect URL to the Payment Link. Customer will be redirected here after payment.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO code for the currency (e.g., INR)

description.description: A brief description of the Payment Link explaining the intent of the payment.

expire_by.description: Timestamp, in Unix, when the Payment Link will expire. By default, a Payment Link will be valid for six months.

first_min_partial_amount.description: Minimum amount in paise that must be paid by the customer as the first partial payment. For INR: 100 paise = ₹1. Default value is 100.

notes.description: Key-value pairs that can be used to store additional information. Maximum 15 pairs, each value limited to 256 characters.

notify_email.description: Send email notifications for the Payment Link.

notify_sms.description: Send SMS notifications for the Payment Link.

reference_id.description: Reference number tagged to a Payment Link. Must be unique for each Payment Link. Max 40 characters.

reminder_enable.description: Enable payment reminders for the Payment Link.

create_qr_code.description: Create a new QR code in Razorpay that can be used to accept UPI payments

close_by.description: Unix timestamp at which QR Code should be automatically closed (min 2 mins after current time)

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer to link with the QR Code

description.description: A brief description about the QR Code

fixed_amount.description: Whether QR should accept only specific amount (true) or any amount (false)

name.description: Label to identify the QR Code (e.g., 'Store Front Display')

notes.description: Key-value pairs for additional information (max 15 pairs, 256 chars each)

payment_amount.description: The specific amount allowed for transaction in smallest currency unit

type.description: The type of the QR Code. Currently only supports 'upi_qr'

usage.description: Whether QR should accept single or multiple payments. Possible values: 'single_use', 'multiple_use'

fetch_order.description: Fetch an order's details using its ID

order_id.description: Unique identifier of the order to be retrieved

fetch_payment.description: Use this tool to retrieve the details of a specific payment using its id. Amount returned is in paisa

payment_id.description: payment_id is unique identifier of the payment to be retrieved.

initiate_payment.description: Initiate a payment using the S2S JSON v1 flow. Required parameters: amount and order_id. For saved payment methods, provide token. For UPI collect flow, provide 'vpa' parameter which automatically sets UPI with flow='collect' and expiry_time='6'. For UPI intent flow, set 'upi_intent=true' parameter which automatically sets UPI with flow='intent' and API returns UPI URL. Supports additional parameters like customer_id, email, contact, save, and recurring. Returns payment details including next action steps if required.

amount.description: Payment amount in paise (smallest currency sub-unit). For INR: 100 paise = ₹1. Example: for ₹100, use 10000

currency.description: Currency code for the payment. Default is 'INR'

customer_id.description: Customer ID for the payment. Must start with 'cust_'

force_terminal_id.description: Terminal ID to be passed in case of single block multiple debit order.

order_id.description: Order ID for which the payment is being initiated. Must start with 'order_'

recurring.description: Set this to true for recurring payments like single block multiple debit.

save.description: Whether to save the payment method for future use

token.description: Token ID of the saved payment method. Must start with 'token_'

upi_intent.description: Enable UPI intent flow. When set to true, automatically sets method='upi' and UPI parameters with flow='intent'. The API will return a UPI URL in the response.

vpa.description: Virtual Payment Address (VPA) for UPI payment. When provided, automatically sets method='upi' and UPI parameters with flow='collect' and expiry_time='6' (e.g., '9876543210@ptsbi')
